questions.question: A company is using EC2 Instances to run their e-commerce site on the AWS platform. If the site becomes unavailable, the company will lose a significant amount of money for each minute the site is unavailable. Which design principle should the company use to minimize the risk of an outage?
questions.explanation: Designing for Fault Tolerance keeps the application running despite component failures, minimizing the risk and impact of an outage. Least Privilege is security, Pilot Light is a DR pattern, and multi-threading is a coding technique.

questions.question: You decide to buy a reserved instance for a term of one year. Which option provides the largest total discount?

options.text: All reserved instance payment options provide the same discount level.

questions.explanation: For a Reserved Instance, the All Upfront payment option provides the largest total discount because you pay everything in advance. Partial Upfront and No Upfront offer progressively smaller discounts.

questions.question: What features does AWS offer to help protect your data in the Cloud? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: AWS helps protect data with access control (A) (IAM permissions/policies) and data encryption (C) (in transit and at rest). Physical MFA, unlimited storage, and load balancing are not primarily data-protection features.

questions.question: An AWS customer has used one Amazon Linux instance for 2 hours, 5 minutes and 9 seconds, and one CentOS instance for 4 hours, 23 minutes and 7 seconds. How much time will the customer be billed for?

options.text: 3 hours for the Linux instance and 5 hours for the CentOS instance.
2 hours, 5 minutes and 9 seconds for the Linux instance and 4 hours, 23 minutes and 7 seconds for the CentOS instance.
2 hours, 5 minutes and 9 seconds for the Linux instance and 5 hours for the CentOS instance.
3 hours for the Linux instance and 4 hours, 23 minutes and 7 seconds for the CentOS instance.

questions.explanation: Amazon Linux is billed per second, so the customer pays for exactly 2h5m9s. CentOS (a commercial/marketplace AMI) is billed per hour with rounding up, so 4h23m7s rounds to 5 hours.

questions.question: What is the AWS Support feature that allows customers to manage support cases programmatically?
questions.explanation: The AWS Support API lets customers create and manage support cases programmatically. Trusted Advisor gives best-practice checks and the Personal Health Dashboard reports events, but neither is the case-management API.

questions.question: Which methods can be used by customers to interact with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: You interact with IAM through the AWS CLI (A) and the AWS SDKs (C) (as well as the console and HTTPS API). Security Groups and NACLs are networking, and CodeCommit is a repository.

questions.question: Which of the following are types of AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) identities? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: IAM identities include IAM Roles (C) and IAM Users (D) (and groups). IAM policies are permission documents, Resource Groups organize resources, and Organizations manages accounts — none are IAM identities.

questions.question: Which of the following Amazon RDS features facilitates offloading of database read activity?
questions.explanation: Read Replicas offload read traffic from the primary RDS database, improving read scalability. Multi-AZ is for failover, snapshots are backups, and automated backups protect data — none offload reads.

questions.question: How does AWS notify customers about security and privacy events pertaining to AWS services?
questions.explanation: AWS publishes Security Bulletins to notify customers about security and privacy events affecting AWS services. ACM manages certificates and the console is a management UI.

questions.question: Which IAM entity can best be used to grant temporary access to your AWS resources?
questions.explanation: IAM Roles are best for granting temporary access via short-lived credentials that can be assumed when needed. Users and groups use long-term credentials, and a key pair is for instance login.

questions.question: A company has a web application that is hosted on a single EC2 instance and is approaching 100 percent CPU Utilization during peak loads. Rather than scaling the server vertically, the company has decided to deploy three Amazon EC2 instances in parallel and to distribute traffic across the three servers. What AWS Service should the company use to distribute the traffic evenly?
questions.explanation: An Application Load Balancer distributes incoming HTTP traffic evenly across the three EC2 instances. Global Accelerator and CloudFront optimize global delivery, and 'Transit VPC' is not a load balancer.

questions.question: Which of the following approaches will help you eliminate human error and automate the process of creating and updating your AWS environment?

options.text: Use AWS CodeDeploy to build and automate your AWS environment.
Use code to provision and operate your AWS infrastructure.
Migrate all of your applications to a dedicated host.

questions.explanation: Provisioning and operating infrastructure as code (e.g., with CloudFormation) eliminates manual errors and automates environment creation and updates. CodeDeploy deploys app code, and dedicated hosts do not address automation.

questions.question: A company is seeking to better secure its AWS account from unauthorized access. Which of the below options can the customer use to achieve this goal?

options.text: Restrict any API call made through SDKs or CLI.
Create one IAM account for each department in the company (Development, QA, Production), and share it across all staff in that department.
Require Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all IAM User access.

questions.explanation: Requiring Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all IAM users greatly reduces the risk of unauthorized access. Sharing accounts and 'two passwords' are insecure, and blocking all API access is impractical.

questions.question: Which AWS Service offers volume discounts based on usage?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 offers tiered, volume-based pricing — the more you store, the lower the per-GB rate. VPC, Lightsail, and Cost Explorer do not offer usage volume discounts in this way.

questions.question: Which of the following factors should be considered when determining the region in which AWS Resources will be deployed? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Geographic proximity to the company's location.

questions.explanation: Region selection should weigh data sovereignty/compliance (B) and cost (C) (prices vary by Region), along with latency and service availability. The number of VPCs is not a Region-selection factor, and all Regions share AWS's security standards.

questions.question: You are running a financial services web application on AWS. The application uses a MySQL database to store the data. Which of the following AWS services would improve the performance of your application by allowing you to retrieve information from fast in-memory caches?
questions.explanation: Amazon ElastiCache provides fast in-memory caches that accelerate read performance for applications backed by a MySQL database. DAX accelerates DynamoDB (not MySQL), Neptune is a graph DB, and EFS is file storage.

questions.question: What are the advantages of using Auto Scaling Groups for EC2 instances?

options.text: Auto Scaling Groups caches the most recent responses at global edge locations to reduce latency and improve performance.
Auto Scaling Groups scales EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones to increase application availability and fault tolerance.
Auto Scaling Groups scales EC2 instances across multiple regions to reduce latency for global users.
Auto Scaling Groups distributes application traffic across multiple Availability Zones to enhance performance.

questions.explanation: Auto Scaling Groups launch EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones, increasing application availability and fault tolerance while matching capacity to demand. Edge caching, cross-Region scaling, and traffic distribution describe other services (CloudFront, ELB).

questions.question: The TCO gap between AWS infrastructure and traditional infrastructure has widened over the recent years. Which of the following could be the reason for that?

options.text: AWS helps customers invest more in capital expenditures.
AWS automates all infrastructure operations, so customers save more on human resources costs.
AWS continues to lower the cost of cloud computing for its customers.
AWS secures AWS resources at no additional charge.

questions.explanation: AWS continually lowers the cost of cloud computing (through economies of scale and price reductions), widening the TCO gap versus traditional infrastructure. AWS reduces (not increases) capital expenditure.

questions.question: Which of the following are examples of the customer’s responsibility to implement “security IN the cloud”? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Building a schema for an application.
Patch management of the underlying infrastructure.

questions.explanation: Security IN the cloud is the customer's job, including building the application schema (A) and encrypting the file system/data (E). Replacing hardware, creating hypervisors, and patching the underlying infrastructure are AWS responsibilities.

questions.question: Which of the following is a type of MFA device that customers can use to protect their AWS resources?
questions.explanation: A U2F security key is a supported MFA device for protecting AWS resources. CloudHSM stores keys, access keys are credentials, and key pairs are for SSH/instance login — none are MFA devices.

questions.question: A company is seeking to deploy an existing .NET application onto AWS as quickly as possible. Which AWS Service should the customer use to achieve this goal?
questions.explanation: AWS Elastic Beanstalk lets you deploy an existing .NET application quickly by handling provisioning, load balancing, and scaling automatically. SNS, Systems Manager, and Trusted Advisor do not deploy applications.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a factor when estimating the costs of Amazon EC2? (Choose TWO)

options.text: The amount of time the instances will be running.

questions.explanation: Security groups (B) are free and hosted zones (D) are a Route 53 (DNS) cost, so neither factors into EC2 cost estimates. Running time, Elastic IPs, and the number of instances do affect EC2 cost.

questions.question: Which AWS Service helps enterprises extend their on-premises storage to AWS in a cost-effective manner?
questions.explanation: AWS Storage Gateway connects on-premises environments to AWS storage cost-effectively, extending local storage into the cloud. Data Pipeline orchestrates data, Aurora is a database, and EFS is cloud file storage.

questions.question: A company is building an online cloud storage platform. They need a storage service that can scale capacity automatically, while minimizing cost. Which AWS storage service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 scales storage capacity automatically and charges only for what you use, fitting a cost-sensitive cloud storage platform. EBS and ECS are not object storage, and Storage Gateway is hybrid.

questions.question: You have just hired a skilled sys-admin to join your team. As usual, you have created a new IAM user for him to interact with AWS services. On his first day, you ask him to create snapshots of all existing Amazon EBS volumes and save them in a new Amazon S3 bucket. However, the new member reports back that he is unable to create neither EBS snapshots nor S3 buckets. What might prevent him from doing this simple task?

options.text: EBS and S3 are accessible only to the root account owner.
The systems administrator must contact AWS Support first to activate his new IAM account.
There is not enough space in S3 to store the snapshots.
There is a non-explicit deny to all new users.

questions.explanation: A newly created IAM user has no permissions by default — there is an implicit (non-explicit) deny until policies are attached, which is why he cannot create EBS snapshots or S3 buckets. EBS/S3 are not root-only, and there is no need to 'activate' IAM accounts.

questions.question: An external auditor is requesting a log of all accesses to the AWS resources in the company’s account. Which of the following services will provide the auditor with the requested information?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudTrail logs all API access to resources, giving an auditor the record of who accessed what and when. CloudFront is a CDN, CloudFormation provisions infrastructure, and CloudWatch monitors metrics.

questions.question: Which of the below options is true of Amazon Cloud Directory?

options.text: Amazon Cloud Directory allows the organization of hierarchies of data across multiple dimensions.
Amazon Cloud Directory enables the analysis of video and data streams in real time.
Amazon Cloud Directory allows users to access AWS with their existing Active Directory credentials.
Amazon Cloud Directory allows for registration and management of domain names.

questions.explanation: Amazon Cloud Directory lets you organize hierarchies of data across multiple dimensions (e.g., org charts, device registries). It is not for video analysis, AD sign-in, or domain registration.

questions.question: A user has opened a "Production System Down" support case to get help from AWS Support after a production system disruption. What is the expected response time for this type of support case?
questions.explanation: A 'Production System Down' case (Business plan severity) has a target response time of one hour. The 15-minute target applies to 'business-critical system down' on the Enterprise plan.

questions.question: Which of the below options is a best practice for making your application on AWS highly available?

options.text: Deploy the application to at least two Availability Zones.
Use Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) across multiple AWS Regions.
Deploy the application code on at least two servers in the same Availability Zone.
Rewrite the application code to handle all incoming requests.

questions.explanation: Deploying the application across at least two Availability Zones is the best-practice for high availability, surviving the failure of a single AZ. Two servers in one AZ do not protect against an AZ outage, and ELB does not span Regions.

questions.question: Which of the following should be taken into account when performing a TCO analysis regarding the costs of running an application on AWS VS on-premises? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: A TCO comparison should include labor and IT costs (A) and cooling/power consumption (B) — real on-premises expenses AWS removes. Software architecture and compatibility are not direct TCO cost inputs here.

questions.question: Your company requires a response time of less than 15 minutes from support interactions about their business-critical systems that are hosted on AWS if those systems go down. Which AWS Support Plan should this company use?
questions.explanation: Only AWS Enterprise Support provides the fastest response target (under 15 minutes) for business-critical systems that are down. Basic, Developer, and Business plans have slower response targets.

questions.question: Which of the following AWS offerings are serverless services? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: AWS Lambda (B) and Amazon DynamoDB (C) are serverless — no servers to manage. EC2, EMR, and RDS require provisioning and managing instances.

questions.question: Which AWS service enables you to quickly purchase and deploy SSL/TLS certificates?
questions.explanation: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) lets you quickly provision and deploy SSL/TLS certificates (free public certs that auto-renew). GuardDuty, Detective, and WAF are security/threat services, not certificate managers.

questions.question: Which AWS Service provides integration with Chef to automate the configuration of EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: AWS OpsWorks provides managed Chef (and Puppet) to automate the configuration of EC2 instances. Config tracks configuration state, Auto Scaling adjusts capacity, and CloudFormation provisions resources.

questions.question: A customer is seeking to store objects in their AWS environment and to make those objects downloadable over the internet. Which AWS Service can be used to accomplish this?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 stores objects and can make them downloadable over the internet via URLs. EBS and Instance Store attach to a single instance, and EFS is a file system, not internet object hosting.

questions.question: Which of the following services can be used to monitor the HTTP and HTTPS requests that are forwarded to Amazon CloudFront?
questions.explanation: AWS WAF is the web application firewall that lets you monitor the HTTP and HTTPS requests forwarded to Amazon CloudFront and control access to your content. CloudWatch monitors metrics generally, but the request-level monitoring described here is a WAF capability.

questions.question: A company is migrating a web application to AWS. The application’s compute capacity is continually utilized throughout the year. Which of the below options offers the company the most cost-effective solution?
questions.explanation: For compute capacity used continuously throughout the year, Reserved Instances are the most cost-effective (significant discount for a committed term). On-Demand, Dedicated Hosts, and Spot cost more or are unsuitable for steady use.

questions.question: A company wants to grant a new employee long-term access to manage Amazon DynamoDB databases. Which of the following is a recommended best-practice when granting these permissions?

options.text: Create an IAM role and attach a policy with Amazon DynamoDB access permissions.
Create an IAM role and attach a policy with Administrator access permissions.
Create an IAM user and attach a policy with Amazon DynamoDB access permissions.
Create an IAM user and attach a policy with Administrator access permissions.

questions.explanation: For a human employee needing long-term access, create an IAM user and attach a least-privilege policy scoped to DynamoDB. Roles are for temporary/assumed access, and Administrator access would violate least privilege.

questions.question: When granting permissions to applications running on Amazon EC2 instances, which of the following is considered best practice?

options.text: Generate new IAM access keys every time you delegate permissions.
Store the required AWS credentials directly within the application code.
Use temporary security credentials (IAM roles) instead of long-term access keys.
Do nothing; Applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances do not need permission to interact with other AWS services or resources.

questions.explanation: Applications on EC2 should use IAM roles (temporary security credentials) rather than embedding long-term access keys, which is the AWS best practice. Hardcoding credentials is insecure, and EC2 apps do need permissions to call other services.

questions.question: Which of the following will help AWS customers save on costs when migrating their workloads to AWS?

options.text: Use servers instead of managed services.
Use existing third-party software licenses on AWS.
Migrate production workloads to AWS edge locations instead of AWS Regions.
Use AWS Outposts to run all workloads in a cost-optimized environment.

questions.explanation: Bringing your existing third-party software licenses (BYOL) to AWS avoids repurchasing licenses, saving cost during migration. Using self-managed servers over managed services, edge locations for production, and Outposts for everything do not generally reduce cost.

questions.question: An organization has a legacy application designed using monolithic-based architecture. Which AWS Service can be used to decouple the components of the application?
questions.explanation: Amazon SQS decouples monolithic components by passing messages through a durable queue so components run independently. A Virtual Private Gateway is networking, Artifact is compliance docs, and CloudFront is a CDN.

questions.question: Which of the following can be used to enable the Virtual Multi-Factor Authentication? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: You can enable a virtual MFA device through IAM (C) and configure it via the AWS CLI (B) (and the console). Connect, SNS, and VPC are unrelated to MFA setup.

questions.question: According to best practices, which of the below options is best suited for processing a large number of binary files?
questions.explanation: Processing a large number of binary files scales best by running EC2 instances in parallel (horizontal scaling), spreading the work across many instances. Vertical scaling and parallel RDS instances do not fit batch file processing.

questions.question: A company is planning to use Amazon S3 and Amazon CloudFront to distribute its video courses globally. What tool can the company use to estimate the costs of these services?
questions.explanation: The AWS Pricing Calculator estimates the future cost of services like S3 and CloudFront before you deploy. Cost Explorer, Budgets, and Cost & Usage Reports analyze costs you have already incurred.

questions.question: What should you do if you see resources, which you don’t remember creating, in the AWS Management Console? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Stop all running services and open an investigation.
Give your root account password to AWS Support so that they can assist in troubleshooting and securing the account.
Check the AWS CloudTrail logs and delete all IAM users that have access to your resources.
Open an investigation and delete any potentially compromised IAM users.
Change your AWS root account password and the passwords of any IAM users.

questions.explanation: If you find suspicious resources, open an investigation and delete any potentially compromised IAM users (D), and change the root account and IAM user passwords (E). Never share your root password with anyone, including AWS Support.

questions.question: A key practice when designing solutions on AWS is to minimize dependencies between components so that the failure of a single component does not impact other components. What is this practice called?
questions.explanation: Minimizing dependencies so a single component's failure does not impact others is called loose coupling. Tight coupling is the opposite; 'elastic' and 'scalable' coupling are not real terms.

questions.question: Which AWS Service offers an NFS file system that can be mounted concurrently from multiple EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) provides an NFS file system that can be mounted concurrently from multiple EC2 instances. S3 is object storage, EBS attaches to one instance, and Storage Gateway is hybrid.

questions.question: Availability Zones within a Region are connected over low-latency links. Which of the following is a benefit of these links?

options.text: Create private connection to your data center.
Automate the process of provisioning new compute resources.
Make synchronous replication of your data possible.

questions.explanation: The low-latency links between Availability Zones in a Region make synchronous data replication possible (e.g., RDS Multi-AZ). They are not for private data-center connectivity, global HA, or provisioning automation.

questions.question: Which of the following are true regarding the languages that are supported on AWS Lambda? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Lambda only supports Python and Node.js, but third party plugins are available to convert code in other languages to these formats.
Lambda natively supports a number of programming languages such as Node.js, Python, and Java.
Lambda is AWS’ proprietary programming language for microservices.
Lambda doesn’t support programming languages; it is a serverless compute service.
Lambda can support any programming language using an API.

questions.explanation: AWS Lambda natively supports several languages such as Node.js, Python, and Java (B), and can support virtually any language using the Lambda Runtime API (E). It is not limited to Python/Node, is not a language itself, and does run code.

questions.question: What are the capabilities of AWS X-Ray? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Facilitates tracking of user requests to identify application issues.
Deploys applications to Amazon EC2 instances.

questions.explanation: AWS X-Ray traces user requests across an application to identify issues (B) and helps improve application performance (C) by revealing bottlenecks. It does not decouple components or deploy applications.
